about.title: Unified Care. Frictionless Socializing.
about.subtitle: Dapet was built to end the hassle of managing fragmented apps for pet care and social life.
about.storyTextOne: Founded in Europe, Dapet is a next-generation pet-tech startup transforming how pet owners care for their companions.
about.storyTextTwo: We consolidate fragmented pet services into one seamless platform. With a single tap, pet parents can find and contact verified local service hubs, manage their pet's complete Digital Health Passport, and consult an integrated 24/7 AI Vet Assistant. Dapet combines social connectivity, smart technology, and instant service access to make premium pet care available to everyone.
about.problemText: Modern pet owners are forced to navigate a maze of disconnected apps — using one platform for socializing, another for medical history, and search engines to locate vets. This fragmentation hurts care quality and wastes time.
about.solutionText: Dapet consolidates pet tech into a single, seamless platform. We combine digital pet identities, AI veterinary assistance, social networking, and service booking on a unified, high-performance architecture.
